CustomField.description: Each joint's current cases a year and supplier in one line, e.g. TKA 40 J&J, THA 10 ZB. For the ROSA Surgeons list on the deal.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Each joint's current cases a year and supplier in one line, e.g. TKA 40 J&J, THA 10 ZB.
CustomField.label: Cases now
CustomField.formula: IF(LEN(IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_TKA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "TKA " & TEXT(ROSA_TKA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_TKA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_TKA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_PKA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "PKA " & TEXT(ROSA_PKA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_PKA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_PKA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_THA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "THA " & TEXT(ROSA_THA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_THA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_THA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "TSA/RSA " & TEXT(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "")) > 0, LEFT(IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_TKA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "TKA " & TEXT(ROSA_TKA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_TKA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_TKA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_PKA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "PKA " & TEXT(ROSA_PKA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_PKA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_PKA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_THA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "THA " & TEXT(ROSA_THA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_THA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_THA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "TSA/RSA " & TEXT(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", ""), LEN(IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_TKA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "TKA " & TEXT(ROSA_TKA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_TKA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_TKA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_PKA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "PKA " & TEXT(ROSA_PKA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_PKA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_PKA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_THA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "THA " & TEXT(ROSA_THA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_THA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_THA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Cases__c, 0) > 0, "TSA/RSA " & TEXT(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Cases__c) & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Supplier__c)), "", " " & TEXT(ROSA_TSA_RSA_Current_Supplier__c)) & ", ", "")) - 2), '')
